Workshops & Seminare

Startzeit 28.10.2025 18:15

Endzeit 28.10.2025 21:00

Zum Kalender hinzufügen: ics Google

Begleiten Sie uns zu einem besonderen VIS x Dialectic-Event, bei dem das Team von Dialectic Einblicke an der Schnittstelle von Technologie, Finanzen und Innovation teilt. Diese Session richtet sich speziell an Studierende, die sich für die Zukunft der dezentralen Finanzen und des Asset Managements interessieren.

Erfahren Sie mehr über die Mission, Vision und Rolle von Dialectic bei der Gestaltung der Zukunft digitaler Vermögenswerte und dezentraler Finanzsysteme. Erhalten Sie einen Einblick in unseren strategischen Ansatz für Investitionen und den Aufbau im DeFi-Ökosystem. Entdecken Sie, wie modernste Methoden des maschinellen Lernens im Asset Management im DeFi-Bereich angewendet werden – mit realen Anwendungsfällen und zukunftsorientierten Perspektiven.

Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, direkt mit Branchenexpert:innen in Kontakt zu treten, Fragen zu stellen und sich mit gleichgesinnten Studierenden zu vernetzen.

⏰Wann: 28.10.2025 18:15

📍Wo: CAB G51

💡Was: Dialectic Talk mit Pizza and Drinks danach

Über Dialectic:

Dialectic ist ein quantitatives Investmentunternehmen an der Spitze der dezentralen Finanzwelt (DeFi) und des maschinellen Lernens. Unsere „compounding machine“ nutzt die besten risikoadjustierten Renditechancen auf den globalen Kryptomärkten. Während DeFi weiterhin ein außergewöhnliches Wachstum verzeichnet, skalieren wir unsere Aktivitäten, um unsere erprobten Strategien einem breiteren Kreis institutioneller Investor:innen und Family Offices zugänglich zu machen.

Ruhige & Kultur Events

Startzeit 1.11.2025 10:00

Endzeit 1.11.2025 17:00

Zum Kalender hinzufügen: ics Google

This event is being held in English.

Where and When:

The contest will take place on Saturday, November 1st from 10:00 until 17:00. We will be initially meeting in CAB H52, please make sure to be there on time!

What

ICPC is the world's largest collegiate coding contest, and once again we are looking for the most talented programmers to represent ETH! The first qualifier round will happen right here in Zurich.

The competition will be individual, you will have 5h to solve as many problems as fast as you can. In total there are 10 to 12 problems. During the event we will provide snacks and drinks.

Among all students satisfying the eligibility criteria (see below) the best will be selected to represent ETH at the South West European Regional contest. [1]

Rules

  • You can choose between various languages, including ICPC's official languages such as C++ and Java.
  • The contest will be held on the computers in the computer rooms in CAB.
  • You are allowed to bring a cheatsheet with at most 25 single sided A4 pages but no other resources are allowed, especially no internet access or statistical language models (e.g. ChatGPT or Copilot).
  • You may bring your own keyboard to the event, note that Bluetooth keyboards might not be able to connect to the computers.
  • Each solved problem gives 1 point, ties will be broken by the sum of submission times where each wrong submission gives a 20 minute time penalty.

Eligibility

In order to participate in the Swiss Subregional contest you need to be eligible to participate in the world finals. To check your eligibility follow this decision tree: [2]

If you want to participate out of competition please contact one of the organizers so we can check for availability. Similarly, if you have any questions regarding the contest or related to this event please do not hesitate to contact us via Discord: https://discord.gg/xvtscPzABC.

Right during Halloween 2025, this year's edition of BjörnCTF will bring you a spooky CTF experience!

Have you ever wanted to try your hand at being a hacker? Then this is your chance! BjörnCTF will feature many different kinds of hacking challenges, from your usual challenges involving websites or binary applications, to onsite challenges involving lock picking and a treasure hunt. Rumours are, that you might even have to defeat a mysterious entity by collecting pages (in a game).

BjörnCTF is aimed both at experienced CTF players and beginners in the Infosec field, with challenges that span many difficulty levels, and all different traditional CTF categories (from pwn to reverse, web and crypto, and misc). Players will need to form teams of max 4 people and there will be prizes for the teams in the top 3 places.

If you want to learn more about what a CTF is and what you can expect, see the CTF Handbook.

For more information, please see our website: https://björnc.tf.
